comment: Ep97 Portugal vs Spain (Play-Offs) — theme 'THE HIDDEN KING AND THE RAGING BULL'. Portugal = A Seleção, carried by the legend of Dom Sebastião, the Hidden King who vanished at the Battle of Alcácer-Quibir in 1578 and is prophesied to return one misty dawn to save Portugal (real, sourced Portuguese folk myth, 'Sebastianismo' — distinct from Legend 088's Navigator/seafaring motif). Spain = La Roja, El Toro, the Raging Bull (motif already used as Legend 087, referenced here as flavor only, not re-carded). OUR PREDICTION Spain 2-1 Portugal (Spain strike first through their young attack; Ronaldo, ageless, levels it 1-1; late, Yamal — the wizard — strikes the winner). Legend 097 = Dom Sebastião, the Hidden King (Portugal). Squads: PORTUGAL Ronaldo(7,c)/Bruno Fernandes(8)/Leão(11)/Dias(4)/Bernardo Silva(10); SPAIN Morata(7,c)/Yamal(19)/Pedri(8)/Rodri(16)/Nico Williams(17) — both sides run 5 named showcases, no squad-accuracy omissions needed this episode. Name-sync onsets match showcase clip starts (Ronaldo/Bruno/Leão/Dias/Bernardo at 55.5/60.3/65.1/69.9/74.7; Morata/Yamal/Pedri/Rodri/NicoWilliams at 90.6/95.08/99.56/104.04/108.52).

lines.text: In fifteen seventy-eight, a young king rode into the mist of North Africa and never rode back. The Portuguese never buried him — they say Dom Sebastião still waits, and one grey dawn, he will return.
And across the border, a different legend runs on younger legs — Spain, La Roja, carried by the Raging Bull, all fire and fury and no patience for waiting.
Welcome back to WorldCup twenty-six Legends — episode ninety-seven. Portugal, versus Spain. A play-off. Win, or the dream dies.
Portugal arrive carrying five centuries of longing. Spain arrive as one of the most complete sides left in this tournament, allergic to losing the ball.
Portugal — A Seleção. Built around a king who refuses to age, and the quiet architect who runs the whole show.
Cristiano Ronaldo, the captain — forty-one years old and still the coldest finisher on the planet, still wearing the armband like it was made for him.
Bruno Fernandes is the heartbeat, the pass that unlocks anything, always demanding the ball in the biggest moments.
Rafael Leão is the explosion out wide, the pace that turns a back line inside out in a single stride.
Rúben Dias is the wall at the back, immovable, the calm that lets everyone else attack with no fear.
And Bernardo Silva is the puzzle nobody solves, drifting through impossible spaces to find the pass no one else sees.
Spain — La Roja. Technical, relentless, and stacked with the best young talent on the continent.
Álvaro Morata, the captain, leads the line with experience and a striker's nose for the biggest occasions.
Lamine Yamal is the wizard — nineteen years old, and already the most feared one-on-one in world football.
Pedri controls the tempo like he has been doing it for twenty years, calm on the ball no matter the noise around him.
Rodri is the engine room, the metronome that never stops ticking, breaking attacks before they start.
And Nico Williams brings the pace and the fearlessness, always ready to run straight at a tiring defender.
So here is the riddle. Does the Hidden King finally return? Or does the Raging Bull charge straight through him?
And stay with me — because this one turns, late, on a single flash of teenage magic.
Here is how we see it. Spain come out sharp and precise, probing for the first crack in the Portuguese wall.
Spain surge down the flank, quick one-touch football, and the whole back line is stretched thin.
And it lands! Spain strike first — the Raging Bull charges, and their bench erupts.
Portugal need an answer, and there is only one man they trust to find it. Ronaldo goes hunting for the equaliser.
And Ronaldo finds it! One-one. Ageless, timeless, exactly when Portugal need him most.
But Spain want more. Late, the wizard drifts inside, and the whole stadium holds its breath.
Yamal strikes! Two-one, Spain. Nineteen years old, and he delivers exactly when it matters most.
Two-one Spain. Portugal were brave and the King nearly held them level, but the Raging Bull found one flash of youth too many.
Our prediction — Spain two, Portugal one. Yamal, late. Not played yet — the real ninety is yours to watch.
And Portugal leave with their heads high — A Seleção, who made one of the tournament's most dangerous sides sweat for every single inch.
Spain march on. La Roja, young and fearless, still charging toward a trophy they believe is theirs to take.
So you tell me — the Hidden King, or the Raging Bull? Comment PORTUGAL for A Seleção — comment SPAIN for La Roja.
They say he waits still, cloaked in the coastal fog, the young king who rode into the mist and never came home.
The players write the night. But Dom Sebastião carries one truth — the fog always lifts eventually, and someone always walks out of it.
Here is how. Go to worldcup twenty-six dot world and create your free account — ten seconds, and Dom Sebastião, Legend zero-nine-seven, is yours.
Then pick three of the forty-eight nations, and every goal they score, scores for you. Free to play, just for glory.
